∀ {F : Type u} [inst : Field F] {Idx : Type u} (asg : Idx → F) (spec : Minidregg.Compiler.PermSpec F 2) (leafW rootW : Idx) (path : List (Idx × Idx)), Minidregg.Compiler.systemAccepts asg (Minidregg.Compiler.membershipGadget spec leafW rootW path) ↔ (∀ sd ∈ path, asg sd.2 = 0 ∨ asg sd.2 = 1) ∧ asg rootW = Minidregg.Compiler.merkleMuxExec spec (asg leafW) (List.map (fun sd => (asg sd.1, asg sd.2)) path)

∀ {F : Type u} [inst : Field F] (spec : Minidregg.Compiler.PermSpec F 2) (k : ℕ) (leaf root : F), (∃ asg, asg Minidregg.Compiler.MWire.leafW = leaf ∧ asg Minidregg.Compiler.MWire.rootW = root ∧ Minidregg.Compiler.systemAccepts asg (Minidregg.Compiler.membershipGadget spec Minidregg.Compiler.MWire.leafW Minidregg.Compiler.MWire.rootW (Minidregg.Compiler.canonPath k))) ↔ Minidregg.Compiler.memberAtDepth spec k root leaf

∀ {F : Type u} [inst : Field F] {Idx : Type u} (asg : Idx → F) (spec : Minidregg.Compiler.PermSpec F 2) (leafW rootW : Idx) (path : List (Idx × Idx)), Minidregg.Compiler.systemSemHolds asg (Minidregg.Compiler.membershipGadget spec leafW rootW path) ↔ (∀ sd ∈ path, asg sd.2 = 0 ∨ asg sd.2 = 1) ∧ asg rootW = Minidregg.Compiler.merkleMuxExec spec (asg leafW) (List.map (fun sd => (asg sd.1, asg sd.2)) path)

∀ {F : Type u} [inst : Field F] (spec : Minidregg.Compiler.PermSpec F 2) (k : ℕ) (asg : Minidregg.Compiler.MWire k → F), Minidregg.Compiler.systemAccepts asg (Minidregg.Compiler.membershipGadget spec Minidregg.Compiler.MWire.leafW Minidregg.Compiler.MWire.rootW (Minidregg.Compiler.canonPath k)) → Minidregg.Compiler.memberAtDepth spec k (asg Minidregg.Compiler.MWire.rootW) (asg Minidregg.Compiler.MWire.leafW)

∀ {F : Type u} [inst : Field F] (spec : Minidregg.Compiler.PermSpec F 2) (leaf : F) (sd : F × Bool) (path : List (F × Bool)), Minidregg.Compiler.merkleExec spec leaf (sd :: path) = Minidregg.Compiler.merkleExec spec (bif sd.2 then Minidregg.Compiler.compressExec spec sd.1 leaf else Minidregg.Compiler.compressExec spec leaf sd.1) path
∀ {F : Type u} [inst : Field F] (spec : Minidregg.Compiler.PermSpec F 2) (leaf : F), Minidregg.Compiler.merkleExec spec leaf [] = leaf
